# Risk Review Record Template

Use this template to document an AI, privacy, safety, or public-interest risk review.

## Status

Draft / In review / Approved with conditions / Rejected / Reassessment required

## Proposal summary

Summarize the proposed system, policy, or deployment.

## Owner

Name the accountable owner and backup contact.

## Intended users and affected groups

Describe who will use the system and who may be affected indirectly.

## Data involved

List data categories, sensitivity, retention expectations, consent basis, and data minimization measures.

## Risk classification

Low / Medium / High

Explain the classification using the criteria in the Risk Review Process.

## Benefits

Describe expected public-interest or user benefits.

## Material risks

List safety, privacy, security, fairness, accessibility, governance, and misuse risks.

## Mitigations

For each material risk, list controls, owners, deadlines, monitoring signals, and rollback criteria.

## Approval conditions

List any limits, required changes, reassessment dates, or unresolved concerns.

## Monitoring plan

Describe post-deployment signals, incident response paths, user reporting mechanisms, and review cadence.

## Decision

Approved / Approved with conditions / Rejected

Include reviewer names, date, rationale, and next steps.
